name: Curtain Bluff All Inclusive Resort
positioning: All-inclusive Relais & Chateaux beach resort on a rocky promontory on Antigua's south side, with the Caribbean Sea on both sides
best_for: Couples wanting a suite with a private plunge pool
Active travelers who want water sports included in the rate
Families using the kids camp on the calm-water beach

facts.text: Curtain Bluff sits on a rocky promontory on Antigua's south side.
The resort is flanked on both sides by the Caribbean Sea.
Curtain Bluff is a Relais & Chateaux hotel.
All meals and nearly all activities are included in the room rate.
All accommodations are situated directly on the sand or a few steps from it.
The Terrace Suite sits at the top of the bluff, with a terrace that has an infinity-edge plunge pool and a daybed.
The bluff suites are split across three levels, with a three-walled living room that opens onto a garden patio.
The spa sits apart from the rest of the resort, just feet from the sea.
Before a spa treatment, guests can sip tea brewed from fresh herbs picked from the spa's garden.
Guests can snorkel on Cades Reef and sail across the bay on a Hobie Cat.
The Cee Bee Kids Camp is based in the shade of the palms on the calm-water beach.
The wine cellar holds over 25,000 bottles, with private tastings in the cellar on Thursday afternoons.

highlights.text: The Pool Suites have private plunge pools and marble fixtures.
The spa's treatment rooms look across the water to Montserrat, Cades Reef, St. Kitts, Nevis and Redonda.
The tennis center has four championship hard courts lit for night play.
A pool for adults offers day beds, beverage service and views of Montserrat.
Curtain Bluff hosts Tennis Challenge Week each November.

considerations.text: Some services, such as spa treatments, tennis lessons and off-property excursions, are not included in the room rate.
Dinner has a dress code: at the Tamarind Restaurant, gentlemen need slacks, a collared shirt and dress shoes.
Children under age 6 are not allowed in the one-bedroom bluff suite.
